_: Unmissed brand ad, built in code (harness/shots/codead.py). Offer of 15 Oct 2026: a premium presence and an AI front desk. Voice timings must match the scene windows in index.html.

vo.text: Your business is losing customers in the gaps.
Every call answered, day and night, in your business's name.
Booked into your calendar. The summary, straight to your phone.
Missed a call? Texted back in seconds.
Every finished job, asked for a review.
And a premium presence, everywhere customers look you up.

music.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals, no acoustic guitar, no ukulele, no piano. 27 seconds. Sleek minimal electronic score for a premium technology brand film, like a product keynote: soft analog synth pads, a deep warm sub-bass pulse at 100 BPM, crisp quiet electronic percussion, glassy arpeggiated synth plucks. Calm, confident, modern, never busy, leaving room for a voiceover. A gentle lift at 21 seconds, then resolve on one clean wide synth chord that rings out to the end.
